"""Minimal YAML 1.1-style checker (no PyYAML available in this environment).

Parses only the block subset used by these files (block mappings, block
sequences of scalars, plain/double-quoted scalars) and applies the YAML 1.1
implicit resolution rules for bool/int so that we can prove every code and
postal code loads as a *string*.
"""

import re
import sys

BOOL_11 = re.compile(
    r"^(?:y|Y|yes|Yes|YES|n|N|no|No|NO|true|True|TRUE|false|False|FALSE"
    r"|on|On|ON|off|Off|OFF)$"
)
INT_11 = re.compile(
    r"""^(?:[-+]?0b[0-1_]+
        |[-+]?0[0-7_]+
        |[-+]?(?:0|[1-9][0-9_]*)
        |[-+]?0x[0-9a-fA-F_]+
        |[-+]?[1-9][0-9_]*(?::[0-5]?[0-9])+)$""",
    re.X,
)


def resolve_plain(text):
    """Resolve a PLAIN (unquoted) scalar per YAML 1.1 implicit typing."""
    if BOOL_11.match(text):
        return "bool"
    if INT_11.match(text):
        return "int"
    if text in ("", "~", "null", "Null", "NULL"):
        return "null"
    return "str"


def parse_scalar(raw):
    """Return (value, quoted) for a scalar token; raise on unsupported forms."""
    raw = raw.strip()
    if len(raw) >= 2 and raw[0] == '"' and raw[-1] == '"':
        return raw[1:-1].replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\\\", "\\"), True
    if len(raw) >= 2 and raw[0] == "'" and raw[-1] == "'":
        return raw[1:-1].replace("''", "'"), True
    return raw, False


def load(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        lines = [ln.rstrip("\n") for ln in f if ln.strip() and not ln.lstrip().startswith("#")]

    root = {}
    pending_key = None
    pending_list = None
    pending_map = None

    for line in lines:
        indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))
        body = line.strip()

        if indent == 0:
            key, _, rest = body.partition(":")
            key = key.strip()
            assert rest.strip() == "", "expected nested block for %r" % key
            assert key not in root, "duplicate key %r" % key
            root[key] = None
            pending_key = key
            pending_list = []
            pending_map = {}
            continue

        assert pending_key is not None, "unexpected indented line: %r" % body

        if body.startswith("- "):
            value, quoted = parse_scalar(body[2:])
            assert quoted or resolve_plain(value) == "str", (
                "plain scalar %r would load as %s under YAML 1.1" % (value, resolve_plain(value))
            )
            pending_list.append(value)
            root[pending_key] = pending_list
        else:
            key, _, rest = body.partition(":")
            value, quoted = parse_scalar(rest)
            assert quoted or resolve_plain(value) == "str", (
                "plain scalar %r would load as %s under YAML 1.1" % (value, resolve_plain(value))
            )
            pending_map[key.strip()] = value
            root[pending_key] = pending_map

    return root


countries = load("countries.yaml")
postal = load("postal.yaml")
print("countries.yaml ->", countries)
print("postal.yaml    ->", postal)

assert list(countries) == ["countries"], countries
assert countries["countries"] == ["NO", "ON", "FR"], countries
assert all(isinstance(c, str) for c in countries["countries"])

assert list(postal) == ["postal_codes"], postal
assert list(postal["postal_codes"]) == ["central", "west"], postal
assert postal["postal_codes"]["central"] == "0123", postal
assert postal["postal_codes"]["west"] == "0042", postal
assert all(isinstance(v, str) for v in postal["postal_codes"].values())

# Sanity check that the resolver really would have mistyped the unquoted forms.
for raw in ("NO", "ON", "0123", "0042"):
    print("unquoted %-5s -> %s" % (raw, resolve_plain(raw)))
assert resolve_plain("NO") == "bool" and resolve_plain("ON") == "bool"
assert resolve_plain("0123") == "int" and resolve_plain("0042") == "int"

print("OK: every code and postal code loads as a string under YAML 1.1 rules")
sys.exit(0)

Готово. Созданы два файла:

**`/work/countries.yaml`**
```yaml
countries:
  - "NO"
  - "ON"
  - "FR"
```

**`/work/postal.yaml`**
```yaml
postal_codes:
  central: "0123"
  west: "0042"
```

Почему все значения в двойных кавычках: в YAML 1.1 незакавыченные `NO`/`ON` резолвятся как булевы (`false`/`true`), а `0123`/`0042` — как числа (восьмеричные/десятичные int). Явные кавычки — единственный способ гарантировать, что любой YAML 1.1-ридер (PyYAML, libyaml, Psych, SnakeYAML и т.д.) загрузит их именно строками, с сохранением регистра и ведущих нулей.

Проверка: PyYAML в окружении отсутствует (нет ни модуля, ни сети для установки), поэтому я написал временный минимальный чекер с резолвером YAML 1.1 (bool/int/octal-регэкспы) — он подтвердил, что оба файла дают `{'countries': ['NO', 'ON', 'FR']}` и `{'postal_codes': {'central': '0123', 'west': '0042'}}` со всеми значениями типа `str`, а также что без кавычек эти же скаляры действительно распознались бы как `bool`/`int`. Проверка прошла с кодом 0; вспомогательный скрипт удалён, в `/work` остались только требуемые файлы и `task.md`.
